nodes.name: Sklearn Neural Network MLP Initialization Atoms
nodes.description: Dense output-activation and Glorot-style parameter initialization helpers used around sklearn multilayer perceptron setup.

nodes.name: mlp_output_activation_name
nodes.description: Choose the output activation name sklearn uses for classifier or regressor heads.
nodes.type_signature: (is_classifier: bool, loss_name: LossName = 'squared_error', label_binarizer_type: LabelBinarizerType | None = None) -> OutputActivationName

nodes.name: mlp_glorot_init_bound
nodes.description: Compute the scalar initialization bound sklearn uses for one MLP layer.
nodes.type_signature: (fan_in: int, fan_out: int, activation: HiddenActivationName) -> float

nodes.name: mlp_init_layer_parameters
nodes.description: Draw one coefficient matrix and intercept vector for a single MLP layer.
nodes.type_signature: (fan_in: int, fan_out: int, activation: HiddenActivationName, random_state: int | None = None, dtype_name: DtypeName = 'float64') -> tuple[NDArray[np.floating], NDArray[np.floating]]

nodes.name: mlp_initialize_parameters
nodes.description: Draw all coefficient and intercept tensors plus best-copy mirrors for a dense MLP topology.
nodes.type_signature: (layer_units: tuple[int, ...], activation: HiddenActivationName, random_state: int | None = None, dtype_name: DtypeName = 'float64') -> tuple[tuple[NDArray[np.floating], ...], tuple[NDArray[np.floating], ...], tuple[NDArray[np.floating], ...], tuple[NDArray[np.floating], ...]]
